measurement_scope: Each sample is a fresh process running the entire case batch; includes startup, pipes, JSON decoding/encoding, and computation. Harness comparison is excluded. Not per-function latency or throughput.
build_cache_policy: Fresh Rust target directory and Go GOCACHE per run; dependency downloads, OS caches, linker/toolchain caches, and machine load are uncontrolled. Build times include dependencies (Rust) and standard library (Go).
agent_costs: Not measured: no model, token, repair, or human-review trial has run. These public seed cases are not a held-out evaluation.

      "description": "Reserve positive amounts within available quota; runtime guards check a nonnegative starting balance and each normal result.",
      "source": "src/quota.ptn",
      "entry": "quota::reserve",
      "case_ids": [
        "quota-success",

        "quota-maximum",
        "quota-exact-exhaustion",
        "quota-minimum-amount-is-rejected",
        "quota-maximum-exact-exhaustion",
        "quota-precondition-fails"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "pair_totals",
      "description": "Sum the first two adjacent pairs of a list, preserving checked arithmetic and access order; ignore later elements.",
      "source": "src/pair_totals.ptn",
      "entry": "pair_totals::pair_totals",
      "case_ids": [
        "pair-totals-normal",
        "pair-totals-negative",
        "pair-totals-short-list",
        "pair-totals-empty-list",
        "pair-totals-overflow-left-first",
        "pair-first-overflow-precedes-second-pair-bounds",
        "pair-second-overflow",
        "pair-extra-elements-ignored"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "summarize",
      "description": "Preserve a UTF-8 label and summarize used plus reserved capacity as total and active status.",
      "source": "src/summarize.ptn",
      "entry": "summarize::summarize",
      "case_ids": [
        "summary-positive",
        "summary-zero",
        "summary-empty-label",
        "summary-unicode",
        "summary-long-label-preserved",
        "summary-overflow",
        "summary-negative-overflow"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
